entries.summary: Powerup system: powerup.gd uses enum Type {HEAL, RAPID_FIRE, SHIELD, BOMB}, falls at DROP_SPEED 80 px/s, drawn as colored circle, collected via distance check in game.gd. Scene root has group "powerup".

Player weapon level system: add_experience(amount) returns bool if leveled up; thresholds EXP_TO_LEVEL [5, 10, 15]; get_weapon_level() returns 1-3; get_shoot_cooldown() returns 0.15s rapid fire / 0.5s base.

Player powerup effects: apply_powerup(type_string) handles heal (GameManager.add_life), rapid_fire (5s), shield (3s), bomb (no-op handled by game.gd). is_shield_active() and is_rapid_fire_active() available.
Player.gd weather effect: SLOW_EFFECT=0.5 for snow, _get_weather_multiplier() checks WeatherSystem autoload/node for get_weather() method, returns multiplier in _process

Weather system: WeatherType enum (CLEAR=0, RAIN=1, SNOW=2, FOG=3), weather_changed signal, methods: get_current_weather(), set_weather(), get_weather_effects(), randomize_weather(), get_spawn_rate_multiplier(), get_player_speed_multiplier()

Weather effects: RAIN reduces visibility to 60% (get_visibility_multiplier), SNOW reduces player speed to 70% (get_player_speed_multiplier, set via set_weather_speed_multiplier), FOG increases enemy spawn rate by 50% (get_spawn_rate_multiplier)
Player weather integration: _weather_speed_mult variable, set_weather_speed_multiplier(mult: float) method, speed calculation in _process() uses SPEED * _weather_speed_mult
WeatherSystem autoload 需要实现: get_weather() -> String, get_spawn_multiplier() -> float
game_manager.gd 新增胜利系统接口：`signal victory_requested(final_kills: int)` 和 `func trigger_victory() -> void`。Boss 击败时调用 `gm.trigger_victory()` 触发胜利画面，信号携带最终击杀数。
ComboLabel 在连击数达到 10 的倍数时触发金色闪烁动画（`_flash_combo_gold`），包括颜色闪白变金再恢复白色，以及弹性缩放效果。检测逻辑在 `_on_combo_changed` 中实现。
